nl_question: How many orders has each customer placed?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

nl_question: What is the average product price?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products

nl_question: Which products cost more than 100 dollars?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100

nl_question: Which customers have spent more than 500 dollars?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) > 500
